# class | query | types (m,tv or blank=all) | expected top-1 ; other titles that must be in the top 5
# A target is m:Title (Year) or tv:Title (Year); the deriver resolves it to a TMDB id and
# checks it against real votes and popularity (see derive_corpus.py).
